title: MAHL: Multi-Agent LLM-Guided Hierarchical Chiplet Design with Adaptive Debugging
problem: LLM-driven chiplet design faces high dimensionality (cores, arrays, memory hierarchies), flattened designs, expensive validation, and imprecise parameter optimization.
method: Multi-agent hierarchical LLM framework with six specialized agents for hierarchical description, retrieval-augmented code generation, diverse validation, and multi-granularity design space exploration.
key_novelty: First hierarchical LLM-based framework with multi-agent collaboration for 2.5D chiplet design generation.
contributions: Multi-agent collaborative chiplet design generation framework
Design space exploration for PPA optimization
Pass@5 accuracy improved from 0 to 0.72 on real chiplet designs
